task_type: supplier gallery parity and regression prevention
requested_outcome: Make the new page for vila_maagel_hashmash match the legacy general gallery and both unit galleries exactly, and prevent shared images or an older bundled fallback from corrupting gallery identity, membership or order again.
natural_destination: The VII place page for vacation-2367, including the main gallery and every unit gallery on desktop and mobile.
authorization_boundary: Local diagnosis, code changes and verification are authorized. Production publication is excluded until Adir explicitly authorizes this release after verification.

lesson_bundle.reason: A code change is not proof that the visible gallery is correct.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires exact natural-destination checks on desktop and mobile in addition to tests.

lesson_bundle.reason: A recurring regression needs a shared invariant rather than another place-specific patch.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires a shared classification rule and an affected-family regression fixture.

lesson_bundle.reason: The reported defect concerns media identity, membership and order.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires exact comparison with approved legacy media and rejection of stale fallback media.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The example looks fixed but another unit that shares images with the general gallery still opens the wrong topic.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Preserve gallery identity by category, topic and source instead of globally removing a shared source.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A regression fixture proves the same source remains selectable in both the supplier gallery and the unit gallery.

predicted_rejections.rejection: An older bundled snapshot silently restores a deleted photo or changes the legacy order.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Treat a non-empty accepted runtime image list as authoritative and use the bundle only to hydrate missing grouping metadata.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A regression fixture drops stale bundled media, orders the general gallery by the accepted runtime list and preserves named-gallery order.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The room card has the right count but clicking it still opens the general gallery.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Test the actual room-topic selection path and URL state, not only the data count.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Both units open their own named topics with exactly 5 and 7 images.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Desktop passes while mobile, reload or a deep link loses the selected unit topic.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Exercise desktop and mobile natural destinations and verify the topic survives URL state.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Desktop and mobile checks open the correct unit topic and retain it after reload.

sources.label: Legacy production gallery membership and order

midpoint_gate.trigger: The shared classification and catalog hydration fixes are implemented.
checks: Shared sources retain both place and unit identities
Stale bundled media is not restored
Exact 28, 5 and 7 image inventories match the legacy page

attack_questions: What happens when every unit image is also present in a supplier gallery?
What happens when runtime images are current but galleryGroups are missing?
Can a stale bundled image reappear in the main gallery?
Does a unit click open the unit topic after reload on mobile?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Exact local candidate page for vacation-2367 on desktop and mobile, compared with the legacy page.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Focused regression tests, production build and exact gallery inventory comparison.

effectiveness.baseline: The public page currently opens a unit click as the general gallery and the hydrated general group contains one stale image in the wrong position.
effectiveness.target: 28 legacy general images in exact order, unit counts 5 and 7 in exact order, zero wrong-topic opens and zero stale media.
